rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00000.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$コード：レッド$$...
　How's the ship holding up?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00001.text:
$$レッド$$
「No problems.
　The ship's control systems are automated,
　so I can operate it alone」
notes: Speaker レッド (short form of コード：レッド) has no standalone glossary key; left as plain text 'Red' pending orchestrator decision on whether to add one, matching how ブルー was split from コード：ブルー.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00002.text:
$$ブルー$$
「The $$グリンアース$$ is in your hands」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00003.text:
$$セツコ$$
「$$グリンアース$$...
　The $$翠の地球$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00004.text:
$$クロウ$$
「A bit much, but not a bad name」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00005.text:
$$ランド$$
「Still, though...
　Those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards sure went and
　built something impressive on someone else's planet」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00007.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Hahahahaha!
　I've been waiting, $$セツコ・オハラ$$ and friends!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00009.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Tch...!
　So we're just $$セツコ$$'s afterthought, huh」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00010.text:
$$ギルター$$
「My apologies.
　But there's no need to worry」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00011.text:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll give the rest of you the same
　overwhelming despair and terror as $$セツコ$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00012.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Good grief...
　Mr. $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ never changes, does he」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00013.text:
$$ランド$$
「You know that guy, old man?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00014.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Say the name $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, and I doubt there's a single
　Sidereal on this continent who doesn't know him」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00015.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Cruel, underhanded, arrogant...
　Basically the number-one man you'd never want as a boss」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00016.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Worst of all, that man...
　thinks he's the smartest person alive」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00018.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Hmph... Taking in a deserter and acting pleased with
　yourselves, are you? Let's see if you can still talk big
　in front of this」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00020.text:
$$クロウ$$
「An invisible barrage... a $$次元転移砲$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00021.text:
$$ギルター$$
「So you've gathered a bit of intel, have you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00022.text:
$$ギルター$$
「The $$次元転移砲$$ transfers energy
　directly onto its target. There's no dodging it」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00023.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But it consumes a massive amount of energy,
　so it shouldn't be able to fire in rapid succession」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00025.text:
$$セツコ$$
「It's up to you, $$クロウ$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00027.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「This operation's success rests on you two.
　Pull it off, and I'll make sure there's a generous bonus」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00028.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that's what I call motivation」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00031.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Our job's to punch through that enemy formation.
　...For now, if you're scared, just close your eyes」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00034.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「W-what... what's that laugh about...?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00035.text:
$$クロウ$$
「When you said you'd even play maid for us, the enemy,
　I figured you were a woman with real nerve...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00036.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Th-that was for the $$スフィア$$'s sake...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00037.text:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've always been surrounded by strong-willed women.
　A reaction like yours is a bit of a novelty, that's all」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00038.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「A-ahaha... I'm honored to be your source of amusement...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00040.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「T-that's right in the middle of the enemy!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00041.text:
$$クロウ$$
「That's exactly why breaking through there earns us
　the bonus. Let's go」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00042.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「W-wait, please!
　I'm not mentally prepared yet...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00043.text:
$$クロウ$$
「No good.
　If I don't get you there within four minutes,
　the operation's a failure」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00044.text:
$$クロウ$$
「So that's how it is!
　Full throttle, here we go!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00046.text:
$$クロウ$$
「We're here!
　Go, $$クラヴィア$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00049.text:
$$ランド$$
「What are you gonna do, $$クロウ$$!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00050.text:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm going with $$クラヴィア$$!
　Hold the front line till then!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00052.text:
$$クロウ$$
「That's the plan!
　Let's go, $$クラヴィア$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00054.text:
$$クロウ$$
「We're here!
　Go, $$クラヴィア$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00057.text:
$$ランド$$
「What are you gonna do, $$クロウ$$!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00058.text:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm going with $$クラヴィア$$!
　Hold this position till then!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00059.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Reinforcements should be arriving soon!
　Please hurry!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00060.text:
$$クロウ$$
「That's the plan!
　Let's go, $$クラヴィア$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00063.text:
$$ランド$$
「Aren't you done yet, $$クロウ$$, $$クラヴィア$$!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00064.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Watch out!
　Reinforcements incoming!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00065.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Quite the tenacity.
　But that ends here」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00067.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear... showing up right when we're weakened -
　just as underhanded as the rumors say」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00068.text:
$$ランド$$
「And on top of that, surrounded by
　those persistent bastards...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00069.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Fufufu... the $$次元転移砲$$, and the
　force I command myself... Truly overwhelming despair!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00070.text:
$$ギルター$$
「From here on, you'll regret ever attacking this base...
　no, regret ever being born!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00072.text:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a cheap man, aren't you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00074.text:
$$ランド$$
「What happened to $$クラヴィア$$!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00075.text:
$$クロウ$$
「As for that, take a look at this」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00077.text:
$$ランド$$
「What's going on here!
　Both the machine and I are in top form!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00078.text:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クラヴィア$$'s the one who did it」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00080.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Turns out that $$次元転移砲$$ runs on
　《$$次元力$$》. So if you adjust it, it can be used
　not just as a weapon, but for recovery and resupply too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00081.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「As expected.
　She's proven worthy of what I saw in her」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00082.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-you bastards...!!
　Damn you all...!!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00083.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Your true colors are showing, $$ギルター$$.
　If you want to keep up the smart act,
　you'd better cut that out」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00085.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Taking it out on us now!?
　You really are small-time through and through」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00090.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Even I can manage this much, if I try...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00091.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn you...!
　That little girl, getting in my way!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00092.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let me tell you, $$ギルター$$.
　$$クロウ$$ wouldn't have had any trouble with an attack
　like yours, even without her cover」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00095.text:
$$クロウ$$
「But I was glad you meant it.
　Thanks, Clavier」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00096.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「No... I'm the one who wants to thank you, Crowe.
　For changing me... thank you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00098.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah, a battlefield romance really is a beautiful thing!」
notes: Longest line 56 chars; dry-run REVIEW warning, provisional guide only.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00100.text:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like he's done it again...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00101.text:
$$ギルター$$
「You bastards!!
　I won't forgive you... not ever!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00102.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Gilter.
　Now then, I'll be your opponent」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00103.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Get ready.
　You're about to be demoted, the fool commander
　who lost the base」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00104.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Get ready, if you please!」
notes: Clavier echoes Crowe's 覚悟しな with an odd polite です tag; rendered as 'if you please' to keep the comic mismatch.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00105.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「All units, begin the attack!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00106.text:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$次元転移砲$$ doesn't scare us anymore!」
notes: 次元転移砲 kept as plain English 'Dimensional Transfer Cannon' (not a glossary key); matches the weapon referenced in context_before 00080.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00107.text:
$$ランド$$
「Now we'll settle it with brute force!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00108.text:
$$クロウ$$
「See ya, Gilter!
　This is where you're finished!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00109.text:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I won't die...!
　Like hell I'll die!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00110.text:
$$ギルター$$
「I will survive, without fail,
　and pay you back for this humiliation!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00112.text:
$$ランド$$
「Shut it.
　If you're leaving, then hurry up and go」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00114.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Heh... If he's got time to spare on a fancy parting shot,
　he ought to hurry up and retreat instead, I'd say」
notes: Longest line 58 chars; dry-run REVIEW warning, provisional guide only.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00115.text:
$$ランド$$
「Old man, you're harsh on him...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00116.text:
$$ブルー$$
「It looks like the Sidereal forces left at the base
　have withdrawn as well」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00117.text:
$$セツコ$$
「There's no sign they destroyed the facility on the way out」
notes: Longest line 60 chars; dry-run REVIEW warning, provisional guide only.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00118.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「For Sidereal, destroying this base
　might carry more risk
　than we imagine」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00119.text:
$$クロウ$$
「I suppose we'll find out if we look into it.
　Right, Clavier?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00121.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Thank you, Crowe.
　I... I feel like I can change, starting today」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00122.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Not 'feel like you can'.
　You've already changed, Clavier」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00123.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「It's thanks to what you said to me
　back then, Crowe」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00124.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... I had a bonus riding on it too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00126.text:
$$クロウ$$
「You haven't forgotten, have you, Advent?
　About the bonus for the operation's success」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00127.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「A promise is a promise.
　I'll add it toward paying off your debt」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00128.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks, Clavier.
　Thanks to you, my debt repayment
　just took a big step forward」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00131.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I'm honored to have been of use!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00132.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Wh-what's with that...
　This is why women are...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00135.text:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll make you fools pay!
　$$次元転移砲$$, fire!」
notes: 次元転移砲, same plain-English rendering as 00106 for consistency.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00136.text:
$$ランド$$
「No good!
　There's no way to dodge it!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00137.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Hurry, Crowe!
　If you can't reach the point within four minutes
　of the operation's start, we'll have to fall back!」

notes: は、はひ… is a speech slip (はい mispronounced); rendered 'Y-yeth...' to preserve it.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00140.text:
$$セツコ$$
「If the battle drags on like this...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00141.text:
$$ランド$$
「Hurry, Crowe!
　If you want that bonus, step on it!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00142.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Dangle a carrot in front of me
　and I've got no choice but to run!
　Clavier, hold on tight!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00144.text:
$$ランド$$
「I've cleared out every last obstacle!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00146.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks!
　Once Advent pays out that bonus,
　I'll treat you all to something!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00147.text:
$$ブルー$$
「Four minutes of operation time have passed!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00148.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Unfortunate, but we'll withdraw once and regroup」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00149.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn it!
　My bonus is toast too?!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00150.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's do this, Clavier!
　You ready?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00151.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Yes!
　I might be small fry as a researcher,
　but I've got some confidence piloting the machine!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00153.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I'll... do my best!
　For myself, and for you, Crowe...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00154.text:
$$ギルター$$
「You...!
　I'll make you pay with your body for mocking me!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00155.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Every word out of you is so shallow」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00156.text:
$$クロウ$$
「If I lost to a guy like you,
　I couldn't face the men I've beaten before!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00157.text:
$$ギルター$$
「If only you didn't exist...!
　If only!!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00159.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「B-but, I... I don't want to die!
　There's something I still want to do!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00160.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Good timing, $$セツコ・オハラ$$!
　I'll capture you right here!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00161.text:
$$セツコ$$
「I won't let you have your way!
　Not with me, and not with this planet!」

notes: ザ・クラ… is cut off mid-word; inferred as an interrupted 'The Crusher' (Rand's nickname per character profile), interrupted by Rand at 00163. Not confirmed via wiki lookup.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00163.text:
$$ランド$$
「Seems like you really want a beating, don't you!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00164.text:
$$ギルター$$
「That bluster ends here!
　Because...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00165.text:
$$ランド$$
「I've got no interest in your boring lecture!
　I'm punching you now! Full force!!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00166.text:
$$ギルター$$
「You really are the Cru—」
notes: Same cut-off ザ・クラ… as 00162, again interrupted by Rand at 00167.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00168.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Understand this, once and for all:
　you lack the strength to be my opponent」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00169.text:
$$ギルター$$
「You...!
　Acting like you've already won?!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00170.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　It's an undeniable fact... call it fate, if you will」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00171.text:
$$ブルー$$
「If we defeat the enemy commander, the battle ends...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00173.text:
$$ブルー$$
「I know someone worthy of being called a true commander!
　Compared to our Captain, you're nothing...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00174.text:
$$ギルター$$
「That $$シャウラス$$...!
　So it's that deserter!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00175.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's right.
　Though it seems odd to say "pleased to meet you" here」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00176.text:
$$ギルター$$
「What an infuriating man!
　I'll make you my first target!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00177.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, how scary...!
　Well, I'll try my best not to die, then!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00179.text:
$$ギルター$$
「Don't tell me... the one piloting that machine is...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00046:00180.text:
$$オリオン$$
「Get out of my way」
